issues.legal_issue: A death sentence should not be commuted where the crime was committed against a public servant because of the performance of official duties and the circumstances provide no reason to reduce the sentence.
material_facts: The case came before the court on an appeal limited to the question of sentence after the death sentence had been confirmed.
The victim was an officer carrying out a ministerial duty by selling land to recover arrears.
The victim had no personal grudge against the appellant and nothing to gain from the sale.
The appellant and his companions lay in wait for the victim; after another companion shot him, the appellant used a sword to cut off his head.
issues.conclusion: The court found no reason to commute the death sentence to imprisonment for life, confirmed the death sentence, and dismissed the appeal; the companion's absconding did not reduce the gravity of the offence.
issues.legal_principle: Crimes against public servants committed for reasons arising from the performance of their public duties must be discouraged and dealt with firmly. The absconding of another accused does not reduce the gravity of the appellant's offence. The court applied no cited earlier cases or statutory sentencing provision in deciding the sentence appeal; the conviction had been under sections 302 read with 34 of the Penal Code.

rule.if: sentence_only_appeal and public_servant_targeted_for_official_duty and victim_had_no_personal_grudge_or_gain and planned_attack_was_extremely_violent

predicates.sentence_only_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal confined to whether an imposed death sentence should be reduced.
predicates.public_servant_targeted_for_official_dut: The offender committed the crime against a public servant for reasons arising from the servant's performance of official duties.
predicates.victim_had_no_personal_grudge_or_gain: The victim had no personal grudge against the offender and no personal gain from the official act that prompted the crime.
predicates.planned_attack_was_extremely_violent: The offender and companions lay in wait for the victim, and the offender carried out an exceptionally violent attack.

issues.definition: When a sentence-only appeal concerns an exceptionally violent planned attack on a public servant for performing official duties, and the victim had no personal grudge or gain, the death sentence is not commuted.
